description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Heliod, adding {C}{C}.
When Heliod dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Heliod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Heliod enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shade's Form by paying {2}{B}, attaching it to Heliod.
Repeat.

uses.name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
